speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Could you please tell me how many weeks pregnant you are and when the abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding started?

speaker: Patient
text: 32-year-old woman, gravida 2, para 1, at 38 weeks' gestation. The patient reports experiencing vaginal bleeding for the past hour accompanied by severe abdominal pain. She mentions that she felt contractions before the onset of the bleeding, but the contractions ceased once the bleeding began. Her first childbirth was a cesarean section due to nonreassuring fetal heart rate.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of high blood pressure or preeclampsia, and have you experienced any recent abdominal trauma? Given your previous C-section and the cessation of contractions with bleeding, I am concerned about placental abruption or uterine rupture.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Vaginal bleeding. I also have Severe abdominal pain, History of contractions that stopped, Previous cesarean delivery.

speaker: Doctor
text: Let me check the fetal heart rate and perform an abdominal exam to assess for uterine tenderness or a palpable scar defect. I will also request a bedside ultrasound to evaluate the placental location and fetal well-being. REQUEST TEST: Bedside_Ultrasound
